scripts.build: bun run --filter @kb.ui/tokens build && bun run --filter @kb.ui/css build && bun run --filter @kb.ui/react build
scripts.test: bun run --filter './packages/*' test && bun test scripts apps/storybook/stories
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run --filter @kb.ui/storybook verify:code && bun run test && bun run test:pack
scripts.storybook: bun run build && bun run --filter @kb.ui/storybook dev
